# Captivating Gyre (M20). "Return up to three target creatures to their owners' hands." Read the
# Tides' bullet (B5c-bullet-return-two-creatures-hand) with up to three. The compiler gives the
# sorcery no tree, so the SpellAbility carrying the effect is added here.
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QAtMost(n=3),
                mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
        }),
    ),
]
